rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the physical measurement of an object.

example.english: The length of this wooden plank is two metres.
example.traditional: 呢條木板嘅長度係兩米。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 muk6 baan2 ge3 coeng4 dou6 hai6 loeng5 mai5

rows.note: Use this for how long something lasts, rather than for its physical size.

example.english: The length of this video is only three minutes.
example.traditional: 呢段片嘅時間得三分鐘。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 pin2 ge3 si4 gaan3 dak1 saam1 fan1 zung1

rows.note: Use this pattern for a piece or measured length of rope, cloth, and other long material.

example.english: I bought a length of rope to tie up the boxes.
example.traditional: 我買咗一段繩嚟綁住啲箱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 dyun6 sing4 lai4 bong2 zyu6 di1 soeng1

rows.note: Use this for the extent or length of a book, article, or other written work.

example.english: The length of this article is excessive, and it makes me sleepy.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅篇幅太長，我睇到眼瞓。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 pin1 fuk1 taai3 coeng4 ngo5 tai2 dou3 ngaan5 fan3
